Leaders of three major world powers met in Shenzhen today for a historic summit. This was followed by a 4-point ‘Peace declaration’.
ThePrint Editor-In-Chief Shekhar Gupta explains twelve takeaways from the trilateral meeting between Trump, Putin & Xi, and how this marks the rise of a new diplomatic triangle. Episode 1940 also looks at the 4 points mentioned in the ‘Peace declaration’ and why Putin is the biggest beneficiary of this summit.
